title: Community Rules & Site Care: One Plan Record for Each Leased Site
content:
Under Community Rules & Site Care, each leased site carries exactly one site-care plan record, and a plan record belongs to exactly one site lease.

**Opening a plan record.** A plan record is opened for a site lease only when that lease has no other plan record that is enrolled or whose plan services are suspended. Whether such a record exists is read from the system's records — the plan records held against that same lease and the status each one shows — and not from the resident's own account.

**Customers with two records.** A customer holds two plan records only while relocating between sites, when the old site's lease has not yet ended. A customer never holds more than 2 plan records.

## The opening condition applied to the records of one lease

| Other plan records held against the same lease | Opening condition |
|---|---|
| none | met |
| only records whose status is ended | met |
| a record that is enrolled | not met |
| a record whose plan services are suspended | not met |

## Points of judgement

- The condition is tested lease by lease: a record held against a different lease does not count against the lease for which a record is being opened.
- **Hypothetical case.** A resident moving from one site to another, whose old lease has not yet ended, holds one plan record for each site — two records, the most a customer may hold.
- **Hypothetical case.** A customer who already holds two plan records does not hold a third.
